records.title: Licensing team pending queue and count across all task types

sources.locator: QueryTasksV2Async: typed rows, total before paging, current source read path
buildTeamTaskRequestPayload: effective category and actual application-only toggle

bindings.meaning: Authorized Licensing department queue with application-only disabled and category all. This source scope does not by itself establish the authenticated manager membership set.
Rows returned by the todo view of the mixed-source team queue under these exact request parameters. Pending is this queue view, not an invented common status code across different source entities.

Count distinct typed (sourceType, sourceId) rows after actual request filtering and any requested verified managed-membership predicate. Read every page before counting or use a total proven to describe that same filtered population; a department total cannot substitute for a subsequently filtered managed-team count.

fields.assignedToUserId: Current handler stable key for the separately verified membership join.
fields.assignedTo: Display name, not a join key.

pagination.total: Server count after request filters but before client-side managed-membership filtering and pagination.

relationships: With applicationTaskOnly=false and category=all, the current query can combine application, profile-verification, enquiry, refund and appeal sources. Actual availability is determined by the authorized deployed response, not this list alone.

With applicationTaskOnly=true, or a specific category constraint, use the independently documented narrower binding. The UI default for Licensing is application-only enabled; observe the current request and controls.

My managed team is a separate predicate: join current task assignedToUserId to the live MyTeamMembers userId set under the same authenticated session, excluding synthetic isSelfMonitor=true entries. Display names, assigned role labels and the department member endpoint do not replace that relation.

The same display task number can appear under different source types. Preserve sourceType and sourceId as typed identity. Unknown assignment remains unknown; no page route, role name or knowledge record grants additional access.
constraints: This is an additional all-type definition, not a replacement for existing application-only definitions. Choose it only when the requested and observed query scope matches all three context parameters.

Do not silently change an explicitly selected category or switch to a personal queue. A broad question does not itself prove which UI toggle is active; preserve known page context or clarify a material ambiguity.
Complete paging, source-specific status meanings and any requested date/SLA predicates remain required. Do not borrow a pending count from another source, filter state or observation.
Knowledge defines query meaning only; current page, operation and record permissions remain enforced. No export, reassignment, role change or other write operation is authorized.
